svg.title: Peacock Feather Mandala — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A detailed circular pattern of peacock eyes, jewel feathers, and gold centers. Full-color library preview; open the SVG to use the numbered mandala-style worksheet. Click a region to apply its suggested color. Shift-click to clear it.
